title: Bay Area Community Resources: the school district’s contractor and the City’s are the same organisation
question: Is the Bay Area Community Resources on the school board’s contracts the same organisation the City contracts with and pays?
finding: Yes, on two keys. 40 of the 127 school-district papers read for it print the contractor’s address as 171 Carlos Drive, San Rafael, CA 94903; the City’s own contract approval notices for Bay Area Community Resources (17 filings, 2018-2025, Board files 184681-22, 200463, 210768, 220458, 230413, 241101) give the same address. Name and address both match. The City payment file itself carries a payee name only, so the tie to the City’s payments runs through the City’s contracts with that name.
how: Text search for "171 Carlos Dr" in the saved school papers (text layer or OCR); Form 126 notices whose contractor name contains "Bay Area Community" and whose address contains "171 Carlos".
limits: An address match ties the two contracting records together; it says nothing about the work done under either.

sources.t: San Francisco Unified School District, BoardDocs: agenda items and contract attachments for seven vendors, 2018-2026 (saved 21 Nov 2026)
San Francisco Ethics Commission: Form 126 contract approval notices (DataSF ite2-5y3b)
